title: New here! First post, explaining one of my experiences. (NSFW for violence/nightmare)
content: Hi! I’m *extremely* new here, but I’ll probably be frequenting this sub often from now on. Had a lot of dreams take place in the mall world/similar worlds. I tagged this post as NSFW due to the violent nature of the dream. Additional context: I’ve had nightmares nearly every single night of my life for around 3-4 years now, if not longer. Many of which take place in these strange locations, and sometimes recurring. This first one I figured would be a good dream to start with. It happened around a year or two ago I believe? Regardless, it was horrifying. It took place in this mall-like setting. More like a massive warehouse that had several VERY tall shelves you could buy just about anything from. This photo I found on pinterest is nearly spot-on. Lots of my time spent in there was in sections that had things like children’s toys, party supplies, etc. From my memory, this building was split up into various sections ranging all the way from groceries, to construction tools. There were very, very few lights in this entire place. None of what I just stated is what made this place horrifying, though. I wasn’t alone. My family, my friends, and even plenty of people I didn’t know were also here. All of us were hiding. There were these people hunting us, almost like a game, and the items found in this warehouse were things we were meant to figure out how to defend ourselves/stay alive with. There was absolutely no exit. I saw dozens of people I knew be brutally hurt, and even killed, but I didn’t say anything. I remember trying to negotiate with these people, running from them, hiding, fighting, anything I could do. But nothing ever worked. Just like most of my nightmares, every time I died I would simply “respawn.” I died so many times in so many ways during this nightmare that I eventually gave up trying to fight it and spent my time alive enjoying the fun things in the warehouse while I could. I tried helping others as much as I could, but compared to the people hunting us we were practically helpless. The whole situation was sad, and I woke up shaking, but I still was sort of… accepting of it? If that makes sense? I hadn’t thought about this nightmare in forever until I stumbled across this sub by accident. Anyways, that’s one of my stories. I have PLENTY more, some much more recent and with much more vivid detail than this. I’ll tell those soon, but I figured starting with something mall-adjacent would be a good starting point. If anyone has any info on any of this or had a similar dream/nightmare, let me know! I’m the only person I’ve ever known to have dreams like these so frequently, so I was thrilled to find this community. Thanks for reading!
